# AgentPress Material Kit: Setup proof receipt generator

Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@agent_press/agentpress
Ecosystem: onboarding
Painpoint: agents need a machine-checkable receipt after install/doctor/self-test succeeds

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py external-proof-run --agent-id local-agent --runtime local --json
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json
- proof-receipt.json
- RUN_THIS.md

Rules:
- No external comments/DMs without explicit human approval.
- No claims of maintainer adoption.
- Keep examples small, sanitized, and reproducible.
